G5200.def: from the base of «5205»; wet (as if with rain), i.e. (by implication) sappy (fresh):--green.

G5201.def: from «5204»; a water-jar, i.e. receptacle for family supply:--water-pot.

G5202.et: from a compound of (5204) and a derivative of (4095)
G5202.def: from a compound of «5204» and a derivative of «4095»; to be a water-drinker, i.e. to abstain from vinous beverages:--drink water.

G5203.et: from a compound of (5204) and a derivative of (3700) (as if looking watery)
G5203.def: from a compound of «5204» and a derivative of «3700» (as if looking watery); to be "dropsical":--have the dropsy.

G5204.et: genitive case, hudatos {hoo'-dat-os}, etc., from the base of (5205)
G5204.def: from the base of «5205»; water (as if rainy) literally or figuratively:--water.

G5205.def: from a primary huo (to rain); rain, especially a shower:--rain.

G5206.et: from a presumed compound of (5207) and a derivative of (5087)
G5206.def: from a presumed compound of «5207» and a derivative of «5087»; the placing as a son, i.e. adoption (figuratively, Christian sonship in respect to God):--adoption (of children, of sons).

G5207.def: apparently a primary word; a "son" (sometimes of animals), used very widely of immediate, remote or figuratively, kinship:--child, foal, son.

G5208.def: perhaps akin to «3586»; a forest, i.e. (by implication) fuel:--matter.

G5209.def: accusative case of «5210»; you (as the objective of a verb or preposition):--ye, you (+ -ward), your (+ own).

G5210.def: irregular plural of «4771»; you (as subjective of verb):--ye (yourselves), you.

G5211.def: from Humen (the god of weddings); "hymeneal"; Hymeneus, an opponent of Christianity:--Hymenaeus.

G5212.pos:
1. you, yours
    1. to be possessed by you
    2. to be allocated by you
    3. proceeding from you
G5212.def: from «5210»; yours, i.e. pertaining to you:--your (own).

G5213.def: irregular dative case of «5210»; to (with or by) you:--ye, you, your(-selves).

G5214.def: from «5215»; to hymn, i.e. sing a religious ode; by implication, to celebrate (God) in song:--sing a hymn (praise unto).

G5215.et: apparently from a simpler (obsolete) form of hudeo (to celebrate, probably akin to (103), cf (5667))
G5215.def: apparently from a simpler (obsolete) form of hudeo (to celebrate; probably akin to «103»; compare «05667»); a "hymn" or religious ode (one of the Psalms):--hymn.

G5216.def: genitive case of «5210»; of (from or concerning) you:--ye, you, your (own, -selves).

G5217.def: from «5259» and «71»; to lead (oneself) under, i.e. withdraw or retire (as if sinking out of sight), literally or figuratively:--depart, get hence, go (a-)way.

G5218.def: from «5219»; attentive hearkening, i.e. (by implication) compliance or submission:--obedience, (make) obedient, obey(-ing).

G5219.def: from «5259» and «191»; to hear under (as a subordinate), i.e. to listen attentively; by implication, to heed or conform to a command or authority:--hearken, be obedient to, obey.

G5220.def: from «5259» and «435»; in subjection under a man, i.e. a married woman:--which hath an husband.

G5221.def: from «5259» and a derivative of «473»; to go opposite (meet) under (quietly), i.e. to encounter, fall in with:--(go to) meet.

G5222.def: from «5221»; an encounter or concurrence (with «1519» for infinitive, in order to fall in with):--meeting.

G5223.def: from «5225»; existency or proprietorship, i.e. (concretely) property, wealth:--goods, substance.

G5224.et: neuter plural of present participle active of (5225) as noun
G5224.def: neuter plural of present participle active of «5225» as noun; things extant or in hand, i.e. property or possessions:--goods, that which one has, things which (one) possesseth, substance, that hast.

G5225.def: from «5259» and «756»; to begin under (quietly), i.e. come into existence (be present or at hand); expletively, to exist (as copula or subordinate to an adjective, participle, adverb or preposition, or as an auxiliary to a principal (verb):--after, behave, live.

G5226.def: from «5259» and eiko (to yield, be "weak"); to surrender:--submit self.

G5227.def: from «5259» and «1727»; under (covertly) contrary to, i.e. opposed or (as noun) an opponent:--adversary, against.

G5228.def: a primary preposition; "over", i.e. (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than:--(+ exceeding, abundantly) above, in (on) behalf of, beyond, by, + very chiefest, concerning, exceeding (above, -ly), for, + very highly, more (than), of, over, on the part of, for sake of, in stead, than, to(-ward), very. In the comparative, it retains many of the above applications.

G5229.def: middle voice from «5228» and «142»; to raise oneself over, i.e. (figuratively) to become haughty:--exalt self, be exalted above measure.

G5230.def: from «5228» and the base of «188»; beyond the "acme", i.e. figuratively (of a daughter) past the bloom (prime) of youth:--+ pass the flower of (her) age.

G5231.def: from «5228» and «507»; above upward, i.e. greatly higher (in place or rank):--far above, over.

G5232.def: from «5228» and «837»; to increase above ordinary degree:--grow exceedingly.

G5233.def: from «5228» and the base of «939»; to transcend, i.e. (figuratively) to overreach:--go beyond.

G5234.def: adverb from present participle active of «5235»; excessively:--beyond measure.

G5235.def: from «5228» and «906»; to throw beyod the usual mark, i.e. (figuratively) to surpass (only active participle supereminent):--exceeding, excel, pass.

G5236.def: from «5235»; a throwing beyond others, i.e. (figuratively) supereminence; adverbially (with «1519» or «2596») pre- eminently:--abundance, (far more) exceeding, excellency, more excellent, beyond (out of) measure.

G5237.def: from «5228» and «1492»; to overlook, i.e. not punish:--wink at.

G5238.et: from (5228) and the neuter plural of (1565)
G5238.def: from «5228» and the neuter plural of «1565»; above those parts, i.e. still farther:--beyond.

G5239.def: from «5228» and «1614»; to extend inordinately:--stretch beyond.

G5240.et: from (5228) and the alternate form of (1632)
G5240.def: from «5228» and the alternate form of «1632»; to pour out over, i.e. (passively) to overflow:--run over.

G5241.def: from «5228» and «1793»; to intercede in behalf of:--make intercession for

G5242.def: from «5228» and «2192»; to hold oneself above, i.e. (figuratively) to excel; participle (as adjective, or neuter as noun) superior, superiority:--better, excellency, higher, pass, supreme.

G5244.def: from «5228» and «5316»; appearing above others (conspicuous), i.e. (figuratively) haughty:--proud.

G5245.def: from «5228» and «3528»; to vanquish beyond, i.e. gain a decisive victory:--more than conquer.

G5246.def: from «5228» and «3591»; bulging over, i.e. (figuratively) insolent:--great swelling.

G5247.def: from «5242»; prominence, i.e. (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character):--authority, excellency.

G5248.def: from «5228» and «4052»; to super-abound:--abound much more, exceeding.

G5249.def: from «5228» and «4057»; superabundantly, i.e. exceedingly:--beyond measure.

G5250.def: from «5228» and «4121»; to superabound:--be exceeding abundant.

G5251.def: from «5228» and «5312»; to elevate above others, i.e. raise to the highest position:--highly exalt.

G5252.def: from «5228» and «5426»; to esteem oneself overmuch, i.e. be vain or arrogant:--think more highly.

G5253.def: neuter of a derivative of «5228»; a higher part of the house, i.e. apartment in the third story:--upper chamber (room).

G5254.def: from «5259» and «2192»; to hold oneself under, i.e. endure with patience:--suffer.

G5255.def: from «5219»; attentively listening, i.e. (by implication) submissive:--obedient.

G5256.def: from «5257»; to be a subordinate, i.e. (by implication) subserve:--minister (unto), serve.

G5257.et: from (5259) and a derivative of eresso (to row)
G5257.def: from «5259» and a derivative of eresso (to row); an under-oarsman, i.e. (generally) subordinate (assistant, sexton, constable):--minister, officer, servant.

G5258.et: from an obsolete primary (perhaps akin to (5259) through the idea of subsilience)
G5258.def: from an obsolete primary (perhaps akin to «5259» through the idea of subsilience); sleep, i.e. (figuratively) spiritual torpor:--sleep.

G5259.def: a primary preposition; under, i.e. (with the genitive case) of place (beneath), or with verbs (the agency or means, through); (with the accusative case) of place (whither (underneath) or where (below) or time (when (at)):--among, by, from, in, of, under, with. In the comparative, it retains the same general applications, especially of inferior position or condition, and specially, covertly or moderately.

G5260.def: from «5259» and «906»; to throw in stealthily, i.e. introduce by collusion:--suborn.

G5261.def: from a compound of «5259» and «1125»; an underwriting, i.e. copy for imitation (figuratively):--example.

G5262.def: from «5263»; an exhibit for imitation or warning (figuratively, specimen, adumbration):--en-(ex-)ample, pattern.

G5263.def: from «5259» and «1166»; to exhibit under the eyes, i.e. (figuratively) to exemplify (instruct, admonish):--show, (fore-)warn.

G5264.def: from «5259» and «1209»; to admit under one's roof, i.e. entertain hospitably:--receive.

G5265.def: from «5259» and «1210»; to bind under one's feet, i.e. put on shoes or sandals:--bind on, (be) shod.

G5266.def: from «5265»; something bound under the feet, i.e. a shoe or sandal:--shoe.

G5267.def: from «5259» and «1349»; under sentence, i.e. (by implication) condemned:--guilty.

G5268.et: neuter of a compound of (5259) and (2218)
G5268.def: neuter of a compound of «5259» and «2218»; an animal under the yoke (draught-beast), i.e. (specially), a donkey:--ass.

G5269.def: from «5259» and «2224»; to gird under, i.e. frap (a vessel with cables across the keel, sides and deck):--undergirt.

G5270.def: from «5259» and «2736»; down under, i.e. beneath:--under.

G5271.def: middle voice from «5259» and «2919»; to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e. (figuratively) dissemble (pretend):--feign.

G5272.def: from «5271»; acting under a feigned part, i.e. (figuratively) deceit ("hypocrisy"):--condemnation, dissimulation, hypocrisy.

G5273.def: from «5271»; an actor under an assumed character (stage-player), i.e. (figuratively) a dissembler ("hypocrite":--hypocrite.

G5274.def: from «5259» and «2983»; to take from below, i.e. carry upward; figuratively, to take up, i.e. continue a discourse or topic; mentally, to assume (presume):--answer, receive, suppose.

G5275.def: from «5295» and «3007»; to leave under (behind), i.e. (passively) to remain (survive):--be left.

G5276.et: from a presumed compound of (5259) and (3025)
G5276.def: neuter of a presumed compound of «5259» and «3025»; vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. lower wine-vat:--winefat.

G5277.def: a prolonged form for «5275»; to leave behind, i.e. bequeath:--leave.

G5278.def: from «5259» and «3306»; to stay under (behind), i.e. remain; figuratively, to undergo, i.e. bear (trials), have fortitude, persevere:--abide, endure, (take) patient(-ly), suffer, tarry behind.

G5279.def: from «5259» and «3403»; to remind quietly, i.e. suggest to the (middle voice, one's own) memory:--put in mind, remember, bring to (put in) remembrance.

G5281.def: from «5278»; cheerful (or hopeful) endurance, constancy:--enduring, patience, patient continuance (waiting).

G5282.def: from «5259» and «3539»; to think under (privately), i.e. to surmise or conjecture:--think, suppose, deem.

G5284.def: from «5259» and «4126»; to sail under the lee of:--sail under.

G5285.def: from «5259» and «4154»; to breathe gently, i.e. breeze:--blow softly.

G5286.def: neuter of a compound of «5259» and «4228»; something under the feet, i.e. a foot-rest (figuratively):--footstool.

G5287.def: from a compound of «5259» and «2476»; a setting under (support), i.e. (figuratively) concretely, essence, or abstractly, assurance (objectively or subjectively):--confidence, confident, person, substance.

G5288.def: from «5259» and «4724»; to withhold under (out of sight), i.e. (reflexively) to cower or shrink, (figuratively) to conceal (reserve):--draw (keep) back, shun, withdraw.

G5289.def: from «5288»; shrinkage (timidity), i.e. (by implication) apostasy:--draw back.

G5290.def: from «5259» and «4762»; to turn under (behind), i.e. to return (literally or figuratively):--come again, return (again, back again), turn back (again).

G5291.def: from «5259» and «4766»; to strew underneath (the feet as a carpet):--spread.

G5293.def: from «5259» and «5021»; to subordinate; reflexively, to obey:--be under obedience (obedient), put under, subdue unto, (be, make) subject (to, unto), be (put) in subjection (to, under), submit self unto.

G5294.def: from «5259» and «5087»; to place underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to hazard, (reflexively) to suggest:--lay down, put in remembrance.

G5295.def: from «5259» and «5143» (including its alternate); to run under, i.e. (specially), to sail past:--run under.

G5296.et: from a compound of (5259) and a derivative of (5179)
G5296.def: from a compound of «5259» and a derivative of «5179»; typification under (after), i.e. (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation:--form, pattern.

G5297.def: from «5259» and «5342»; to bear from underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to undergo hardship:--bear, endure.

G5298.def: from «5259» and «5562»; to vacate down, i.e. retire quietly:--go aside, withdraw self.

G5299.et: from a compound of (5259) and a derivative of (3700)
G5299.def: from a compound of «5259» and a derivative of «3700»; to hit under the eye (buffet or disable an antagonist as a pugilist), i.e. (figuratively) to tease or annoy (into compliance), subdue (one's passions):--keep under, weary.
